headline: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs under AI-driven IT overhaul
summary: Qantas will cut or outsource 850 Australian jobs, mostly moving roles to India, as part of an AI-driven overhaul of its IT systems, with CEO Vanessa Hudson citing an Accenture partnership amid unprecedented technological disruption.

claims.statement: Qantas will cut/outsource 850 Australian jobs, with most roles moving to India, under an AI-driven overhaul.

sources.quote: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
Qantas to outsource 850 local jobs with most roles moving to India
The Australian airline said the move was aimed at modernising its IT systems and noted the impact of AI.

claims.statement: Qantas CEO Vanessa Hudson cited an Accenture agreement amid unprecedented technological disruption.

sources.quote: Australian carrier announces agreement with Accenture amid ‘unprecedented’ technological disruption, CEO Vanessa Hudson says
